words.ex: He will call you upon his arrival.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给你打电话。
words.en: On or onto a surface or position above or on top of something.

words.ex: Once upon a time, a boy lived in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 从前，一个男孩住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: Used at the beginning of a story to indicate that it happened a long time ago.

words.tr:
n. 咬；咬伤；上钩；
v. 咬；叮；上钩；
words.ex: The dog gave him a sudden bite.
words.ex_cn: 狗突然咬了他一口。
words.en: If an animal or person bites you, they use their teeth to cut into your flesh.

words.ex: The dog managed to bite through the rope.
words.ex_cn: v. 狗设法咬断了绳子。
words.en: To penetrate or cut through something with the teeth.

words.tr:
adj. 净余的；
n. 网；
words.ex: The net profit after taxes is $500.
words.ex_cn: 缴税后的净收益是500美元。
words.en: A net is a piece of thin fabric or thread that is used to catch fish, insects, or other small animals. It can also refer to the amount of money remaining after all expenses have been deducted.

words.ex: The hunter caught a deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 猎人在森林里捕到了一只鹿。
words.en: A hunter is a person who hunts wild animals for food or as a sport.

words.tr:
v. 承诺；答应；
n. 许诺；希望；成功的征兆（或理由）；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: A promise is a statement that you will definitely do something or that something will definitely happen.

words.ex: Long ago, there was a kingdom in this land.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，这片土地上有一个王国。
words.en: A long time in the past.

words.ex: The war ended last year.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争去年结束了。
words.en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

words.ex: My neighbour gives me apples from his tree.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居从他的树上给我摘苹果。
words.en: A neighbour is someone who lives near you, especially in the next house or flat.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫躺在沙发上。
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.ex: He pretends to sleep when his mom asks him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈让他打扫房间时，他假装睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.tr:
n. 官员；高级职员；
adj. 官方的；正式的；
words.ex: The official announced new rules for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员宣布了节日的新规定。
words.en: An official is a person who holds a position of authority in a government or organization, or something that is authorized or formally recognized.

words.ex: His silly hat made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他那可笑的帽子让大家都笑了。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is silly, you mean that they are foolish, childish, or ridiculous.

words.ex: He decides to go home early.
words.ex_cn: 他决定早点回家。
words.en: If you decide to do something, you choose to do it, usually after you have thought carefully about the other possibilities.

words.ex: His hard work received much praise from the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力工作得到了老师的许多赞美。
words.en: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

words.ex: He is afraid of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.ex: Suddenly, the light went out.
words.ex_cn: 突然，灯灭了。
words.en: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.ex: He can tell the truth to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他可以对他的老师说实话。
words.en: To speak honestly; to not lie or deceive.

words.ex: He makes money by selling cakes.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卖蛋糕赚钱。
words.en: To earn or obtain money through work, investment, or other means.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是真实的。
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.ex: He told the dog to get out.
words.ex_cn: 他让狗出去。
words.en: To leave or escape from a place or situation.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the head of state of that country.

words.ex: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or hobby.

words.ex: He ran quickly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: In a fast or rapid manner.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.ex: The duckling swims behind its mother.
words.ex_cn: 小鸭子跟在妈妈后面游泳。
words.en: A duckling is a young duck.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；真正的；
words.ex: This is a real diamond, not fake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石，不是假的。
words.en: Something that is real actually exists and is not imagined, invented, or theoretical.

words.ex: They laugh at his funny hat.
words.ex_cn: 他们因他的滑稽帽子而发笑。
words.en: To laugh at someone or something means to mock or ridicule them, often in a way that is not kind.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；外出；（症状）消失
words.ex: Go away, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 走开，我需要休息。
words.en: To leave a place or to stop being present in a situation.

words.tr:
n. 探究；搜索；
v. 搜索；搜寻；
words.ex: The search for truth took many years.
words.ex_cn: 对真理的探究花了多年时间。
words.en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them because you want to find them.

words.ex: He is searching for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他正在找他的钥匙。
words.en: To look for something carefully and thoroughly.

words.ex: The hen is laying eggs in the coop.
words.ex_cn: 母鸡正在鸡舍里下蛋。
words.en: A hen is a female chicken, especially one that is kept for its eggs.

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.tr:
v. （猫等满足地）发出呼噜声；（机器等）发出隆隆声；（人）轻柔地说话
n. （猫发出的）咕噜声；（机器等）颤动声
words.ex: The cat purrs when she is happy.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫在开心时会发出呼噜声。
words.en: When a cat purrs, it makes a low, continuous, vibrating sound that shows it is contented.

words.tr: v. 放置；安放；下蛋；“lie”的过去式； adj. 外行的；非专业的；
words.ex: He lay the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: To put something down gently or carefully.

words.ex: A white swan swam quietly on the lake.
words.ex_cn: 一只白天鹅静静地在湖上游泳。
words.en: A swan is a large, white bird with a long neck that lives on rivers and lakes.

words.ex: The bird has a soft feather.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟有一根柔软的羽毛。
words.en: One of the light, horny structures that form the principal covering of birds.

words.tr: 短语. 令某人惊讶的是（sd 为 somebody 的缩写）
words.ex: To his surprise, the dog caught the ball.
words.ex_cn: 令他惊讶的是，狗接住了球。
words.en: To the surprise of someone named SD.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.ex: I believe you are telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你在说真话。
words.en: If you believe in something, you think that it is true, or that it exists.

words.ex: You can enter the room only if you have a pass.
words.ex_cn: 只有当你有通行证时，你才能进入房间。
words.en: Used to say that something will happen or be true just in one particular situation.

words.ex: The fisherman catches fish every morning.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫每天早上捕鱼。
words.en: A fisherman is a man who catches fish as a job or for sport.

words.tr: n. 钓鱼；捕鱼； v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；“fish”的现在分词；
words.ex: He likes fishing by the lake every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每周末去湖边钓鱼。
words.en: Fishing is the activity of trying to catch fish.

words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨停后太阳出来了。
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: n. （阿拉伯和波斯神话故事中的）精灵；魔仆
words.ex: The genie emerged from the lamp, ready to grant three wishes.
words.ex_cn: 妖怪从灯里冒出来，准备实现三个愿望。
words.en: In stories, a genie is a spirit which looks like a small person and has magic powers.

words.ex: The old tree died last winter.
words.ex_cn: 那棵老树去年冬天死了。
words.en: To die means to stop living and become dead.

words.ex: He make a promise to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit oneself to a future action or outcome.

words.ex: Someone left their bag on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 有人把包落在椅子上了。
words.en: You use someone to refer to a person without saying exactly who you mean.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.tr: adj. 丰饶的；富有的；富裕的；
words.ex: The land is rich in minerals.
words.ex_cn: 这片土地矿物丰富。
words.en: Having a great deal of money or assets; wealthy.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.ex: Anyone can learn to read.
words.ex_cn: 任何人都能学会阅读。
words.en: Any person at all; it does not matter who.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 成功做某事；在做某事上取得成功
words.ex: He will succeed in doing his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他会成功地按时完成作业。
words.en: To achieve a desired outcome or goal through effort.

words.ex: He cleaned the room himself.
words.ex_cn: 他亲自打扫了房间。
words.en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the male subject of the verb is also the object

words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.tr: 专有名词. 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生，丹麦著名童话作家，代表作有《丑小鸭》《卖火柴的小女孩》等
words.ex: Hans Christian Andersen wrote many fairy tales.
words.ex_cn: 安徒生写了许多童话故事。
words.en: A 19th-century Danish author renowned for his fairy tales, including 'The Little Mermaid' and 'The Ugly Duckling', which have become classics of children's literature.
